items.title: 主线 EP1：立项计划（示例）
items.summary: 这是一张示例卡片。真实卡片由管家或 agent 用 stateutil.py upsert-item 写入。点开它看看详情页：草稿、把握度、时间线，以及底部的 批准 / 驳回 / 完成。
items.summary_en: This is a sample card. Real cards are written by the manager or an agent with stateutil.py upsert-item. Open it to see the detail view: the draft, confidence, the timeline, and Approve / Reject / Done at the bottom.
items.draft:
## 计划

| 阶段 | 产出 | 负责 |
|---|---|---|
| 选题论证 | 一页 brief | 研究员 |
| 脚本 | 口播稿 v1 | 编剧 |
| 封面 | 3 版缩略图 | 美术 |

批准后编剧才会开始执行；驳回时写原因，管家会把原因整理成规则提议。
items.draft_en:
## Plan

| Stage | Output | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Topic case | One-page brief | Researcher |
| Script | Voice-over script v1 | Writer |
| Thumbnail | 3 thumbnail options | Artist |

The writer starts only after you approve. If you reject, give a reason; the manager turns reasons into rule proposals.
